title: The Company's Servant
description: Off the ship at York with a five-year contract and the Factor's eye on you, then up the rivers to Edmonton House, where the Nor'Westers live a stone's throw away and the Beaver Hills Cree decide whose friends they are. The HBC story; the history runs underneath it.

beats.title: The Blackfoot take horses from the Beaver Hills camp
beats.rumour: The Beaver Hills Cree are watching their horse herd at night.

happens.text: Word comes in to Edmonton House: Blackfoot raiders have run off the Beaver Hills Cree horse herd, and a young man is dead. The chief's people are asking for you.

questlines.title: The Company's Servant
questlines.summary: From the ship at York to the Company's books at Edmonton House.

quests.title: Report to the Factor
quests.summary: You are the Company's newest servant, and the Factor will want you the hour you land.

on_complete.text: You are on the books of Edmonton House now: six twists of tobacco and four pieces of goods for the road.

objectives.text: Find the Factor and report to him

dialogue.text: {npc} looks you over as he would a new axe. "So you're the Orkney lad. Five years, the contract says. Can you carry, and can you hold your tongue?"

choices.label: "I can do both, sir. Put me to work."
choices.reply: "Good. The ship's boats are at the landing. Every piece to the warehouse, and none of it opened."

choices.label: "I can do both, sir. Put me to work."
choices.reply: "Good. The woodpile is a disgrace. Six loads before you eat."

choices.label: "I signed on for the trade, sir, not the warehouse."
choices.reply: "Every man who ever traded here began in the warehouse. So will you."

choices.label: "I signed on for the trade, sir, not the woodpile."
choices.reply: "Every man who ever traded here began at the woodpile. So will you."

objectives.text: Carry six lots from the ship's boats to the warehouse
Bring six loads of firewood to the woodpile
Report back to the Factor

dialogue.text: {npc} hardly looks up from his ledger. "You'll do. Edmonton House wants hands, and a man who can carry and keep his mouth shut is worth two who can't. You're for the Saskatchewan."

choices.label: "Edmonton House, sir?"
choices.reply: "On the North Saskatchewan, a thousand miles up. The Nor'Westers have Fort Augustus beside it - near enough to hear them sing. The Beaver Hills Cree trade there, and the Blackfoot when they please."

choices.label: "How do I get there?"
choices.reply: "The York boats go up to Cumberland House on the fifth of September; from there you'll find your way. Or walk, if you're a fool. The river is the road."

choices.label: "I'll go, sir."
choices.reply: "Of course you will. The storeman will give you your outfit."

quests.title: Up the rivers
quests.summary: A thousand miles of river between York and Edmonton House.

objectives.text: Go inland to Edmonton House (the York boats leave for Cumberland House on 5 September)

quests.title: Edmonton House
quests.summary: Report to the master of Edmonton House.

objectives.text: Report to the master of Edmonton House

dialogue.text: {npc} reads the York letter twice. "One more mouth, and the winter coming. Well. You'll learn two things here or you'll go home in a box: the Nor'Westers across the way, and the Cree who decide whether we eat. Go and look at both."

questlines.title: The Other House
questlines.summary: The Nor'Westers at Fort Augustus, a stone's throw from your gate.

quests.title: The neighbours
quests.summary: Call at Fort Augustus and see what kind of men the Nor'Westers are.

objectives.text: Call on the master of Fort Augustus

dialogue.text: {npc} meets you at his gate with a pipe in his hand. "So York has sent another clerk to count our canoes. Come in, if you're coming. We don't bite before dinner."

choices.label: Share his pipe and the news from the Bay
Pay your respects and say as little as you can
Tell him to keep his men away from the Company's hunters

do.why: a Company man warned off the Nor'Westers at Fort Augustus

objectives.text: Tell your master how it went

dialogue.text: "Friendly, was he? He is always friendly. Drink his rum and keep your counsel - every word you give him is a word the Company paid for."

objectives.text: Tell your master how it went

dialogue.text: "Said little and heard much? That's the way of it. You'll do here."

objectives.text: Tell your master how it went

dialogue.text: "You told him that? To his face?" {npc} laughs despite himself. "Well, he knows where we stand now. Mind your back on the river."

quests.title: A quiet arrangement
quests.summary: The Nor'Westers' master proposes that neither house carry rum to the Beaver Hills camp this winter, so the Cree trade for goods and not for drink. He asks you to put it to your master.

objectives.text: Put the Nor'Westers' offer to your master

dialogue.text: {npc} hears you out with his arms folded. "No rum to the Beaver Hills camp, theirs or ours. And how do I know they'll keep to it?"

choices.label: Argue for it: a sober camp hunts, and pays its debts

do.why: the houses at Edmonton agree to carry no rum to the Beaver Hills camp

choices.label: Advise against it: the Canadians will break it at the first chance

objectives.text: Take your master's answer to Fort Augustus

dialogue.text: "He agreed? Then you've done a better day's work than either of us." {npc} gives you his hand. "No rum to the Beaver Hills this winter. Let's see who keeps it."

objectives.text: Take your master's answer to Fort Augustus

dialogue.text: {npc} shrugs. "I thought as much. Well, the Cree will drink our rum, then, and pay our debts."

quests.title: Ahead of the Canadians
quests.summary: The Nor'Westers are sending goods out to the Beaver Hills camp. Your master wants the Company's there first.

objectives.text: Carry four pieces of goods to the Beaver Hills Cree before the Nor'Westers' runners

dialogue.text: {npc} looks over the goods. "The Canadians promised us the same. You came first."

on_done.why: the Company beat the Nor'Westers to the Beaver Hills camp

objectives.text: Tell your master the goods are in

dialogue.text: "Good. They'll be sour across the way tonight. Sleep with your knife."

questlines.title: The Company's Friends
questlines.summary: The Beaver Hills Cree, who trade at Edmonton House - and decide whether it eats.

quests.title: Tobacco and talk
quests.summary: Go out to the Beaver Hills Cree camp and make yourself known, as is proper.

on_complete.text: You have sat in council with the Beaver Hills Cree.

objectives.text: Go out to the Beaver Hills Cree camp
Give the chief tobacco, as is proper

dialogue.text: {npc} takes the tobacco, fills a pipe, and passes it to you before he says a word.

objectives.text: Sit with the chief and hear him out

dialogue.text: "The Company's men come and go," {npc} says through the smoke. "Some keep their word. At the last moon the Blackfoot took twenty of our horses, and the Canadians across the river sold them powder. What is the Company's friendship worth?"

choices.label: Say the Company's friendship is not only for trade, and mean it
Ask him to teach you the words for it, in Cree

quests.title: The invitation
quests.summary: The buffalo are near, and the Beaver Hills Cree are riding out. Their chief asks whether the Company's man rides with them.

on_complete.text: You rode with the Beaver Hills Cree and ate at their fire. They will remember who stood with them.

objectives.text: Answer the chief's invitation

dialogue.text: "We ride when the scouts come back," {npc} says. "A man who hunts with us eats with us."

choices.label: "I must ask my master's leave first."

objectives.text: Ask your master's leave to ride with the Cree

dialogue.text: "Go, and bring back meat. A man the Cree hunt with is worth ten the Cree don't."

objectives.text: Ride with the Beaver Hills Cree and bring down a buffalo
Eat with the chief after the hunt

dialogue.text: The meat is shared out, and {npc} gives you the tongue, the best of it. "You ride like a white man, but you ride with us. When the grass is green the Blackfoot will come for horses again. Then we will see who stands with us."
